msg: There are two distinct groups of gnomes (Group 1 = Green, Yellow, Orange, and Brown gnomes)(Group 2 = Pink,    Red,    Blue,      and Purple gnomes)Each colour gnome in group 1 brings you to the same forest (Group 1 forest). Each colour gnome in group 2 brings you to the same forest (Group 2 forest).The two groups bring you to different forests. At different points in the game one forest will return more mushrooms than the other (e.g., the Group 1 forest might start off with more mushrooms than the Group 2 forest).However, the forest that returns the most mushrooms can change so it is important that you try out the different groups during the experiment if the number of mushrooms starts to drop.
